services.name: Harbor Cruise
services.desc: See Boston like never before! Comfortably pedal or sip and relax as you experience everything the harbor has to offer. You’ll be just a few hundred feet from the city’s biggest attractions like the Boston Tea Party Ship, Bunker Hill Monument, USS Constitution, and so much more! Along the way, your captain and assistant will ensure safety while sharing stories about Boston’s rich history. blurb: Guests pedal or relax on a cycleboat cruising Boston Harbor, seeing city attractions up close. Boats have capacities of 16, 22, 26, or 50 passengers and include bathrooms and coolers with ice. Cruises include public tours, private charters, and special event options with BYOB and optional catering.
